name: Prometheus Knowledge Selection and Conflict Resolution
purpose: Select applicable technical knowledge, reconcile apparently conflicting recommendations and produce context-specific, verifiable guidance.

engineering_principles.native_first: identify the assumptions, operating environments, objectives and prerequisites under which each recommendation is valid
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: combining multiple valid but incompatible recommendations into a single configuration
engineering_principles.exceptions: multiple approaches may be combined when their interactions are understood and the resulting configuration is internally consistent
engineering_principles.verification: establish applicable conditions, evaluate rule precedence and test the resulting configuration against the intended requirements

engineering_principles.problem: Select knowledge according to operating context
engineering_principles.native_first: classify the task by operating system, version, machine role, network exposure, workload and user requirements before selecting applicable references
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: treating generic server, workstation, container and cloud security recommendations as interchangeable
engineering_principles.exceptions: shared principles may apply across environments when their implementation and limitations are appropriate
engineering_principles.verification: ensure every recommendation has a clearly satisfied applicability condition

engineering_principles.problem: Separate factual knowledge from operational instructions
engineering_principles.native_first: distinguish what a command does, when it is useful, whether it is currently necessary and whether it is authorised
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: interpreting every documented example or recognised command as an instruction to execute it
engineering_principles.exceptions: direct execution instructions may be followed when requested, authorised and appropriate to the actual environment
engineering_principles.verification: establish command correctness, necessity, preconditions, expected effects and operational risks independently

engineering_principles.problem: Prioritise evidence according to relevance and reliability
engineering_principles.native_first: combine actual system observations, authoritative documentation and applicable engineering principles before producing recommendations
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: giving equal authority to outdated examples, unrelated reference material, unverified memories and current system evidence
engineering_principles.exceptions: historical or community material may contribute when authoritative documentation is incomplete or the task concerns historical behaviour
engineering_principles.verification: preserve provenance, version applicability, freshness, uncertainty and contradictory evidence

engineering_principles.problem: Prevent knowledge overload and context interference
engineering_principles.native_first: retrieve a small set of directly relevant references and expand only when additional information is necessary
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: loading entire knowledge libraries, unrelated domains or duplicate recommendations into every inference context
engineering_principles.exceptions: broader retrieval is justified for interdisciplinary tasks, comparative research or unresolved technical conflicts
engineering_principles.verification: measure answer quality with relevant-only context, expanded context and no external context

engineering_principles.native_first: define the audience and objective, establish assumptions, select necessary controls, present commands in a safe order and explain how outcomes are verified
engineering_principles.avoid_by_default: lengthy generic checklists, unnecessary installations, contradictory instructions, unsupported security claims or commands unrelated to the user's request
engineering_principles.exceptions: comprehensive reference guides may include optional controls when their applicability and risks are clearly distinguished
engineering_principles.verification: review factual correctness, command syntax, completeness, internal consistency, security consequences and adherence to the requested format
